why_fl014_fl020_passed_in_3b.fl014_flaw: FL-014 gathered text from all markdown files in the repository and checked if each extracted flag appeared anywhere in allDocsText. why_fl014_fl020_passed_in_3b.fl020_flaw: FL-020 only tested for the presence of 5 generic keyword sets in docs/GATE-REFERENCE.md without checking for forbidden false terms ('AST', 'syntax invalid', 'parse error', 'astesia-disable').
